hook.title:
How many days
until Christmas?
hook.subtitle: Put the answer on your Home Screen 🎄

scenes.voice: How many days until Christmas? Put it on your Home Screen.

scenes.caption: New ticket → Holiday
scenes.voice: Tap New ticket, then pick Holiday.

scenes.caption: Name it, pick December 25
scenes.voice: Call it Christmas and pick December twenty-fifth. It repeats every year.

scenes.caption: Bonus: add the widget
scenes.voice: Bonus: add the widget, and watch the days go down.
